questions.question: Consider the following statement and choose the option that follows. Statement: A significant percentage of urban professionals are enrolling in online mindfulness and meditation programs. Conclusion I. Professionals are prioritizing their mental well-being. Conclusion II. Traditional therapy centers are no longer being visited. ?
questions.questionHtml:
Consider the following statement and choose the option that follows.

Statement: A significant percentage of urban professionals are enrolling in online mindfulness and meditation programs.

Conclusion I. Professionals are prioritizing their mental well-being.

Conclusion II. Traditional therapy centers are no longer being visited. ?
questions.solution:
I. Professionals are prioritizing their mental well-being. → Follow

Enrolling in mindfulness and meditation programs indicates a growing focus on mental health and well being among professionals.

II. Traditional therapy centers are no longer being visited. → Does not Follow

The statement does not say that professionals have stopped visiting traditional therapy centers.

Thus, Only Conclusion I follows.

questions.question: Consider the following statements and identify the logical relationship. I. The municipal corporation initiated a massive waste segregation drive. II. A large number of residents are still disposing of mixed waste in public bins. ?
questions.questionHtml:
Consider the following statements and identify the logical relationship.

I. The municipal corporation initiated a massive waste segregation drive.

II. A large number of residents are still disposing of mixed waste in public bins. ?

options.text: I is the cause and II is the effect
options.html: I is the cause and II is the effect

options.text: II is the cause and I is the effect
options.html: II is the cause and I is the effect

options.text: Both are effects of the same cause
options.html: Both are effects of the same cause

questions.solution:
I. The municipal corporation initiated a massive waste segregation drive.

This statement addresses the initiative taken by the municipal corporation.

II. A large number of residents are still disposing of mixed waste in public bins.

This statement focuses on the public behavior.

So, mixed waste disposal also does not cause the initiation of the drive. Therefore there is no relation between the two statements.

questions.question: Read the given statement and conclusions carefully. Decide which of the given conclusions is definitely TRUE from the statement. Statement: A > B < C ≤ D = E ≥ F > G Conclusion I: B < E Conclusion II: F > D ?
questions.questionHtml:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully. Decide which of the given conclusions is definitely TRUE from the statement.

Statement: A > B < C ≤ D = E ≥ F > G

Conclusion I: B < E

Conclusion II: F > D ?

options.text: Both Conclusion I and Conclusion II are True
options.html: Both Conclusion I and Conclusion II are True

options.text: Both Conclusion I and Conclusion II are False
options.html: Both Conclusion I and Conclusion II are False

questions.solution:
I) B < E → True (As A > B < C ≤ D = E ≥ F > G. So, we get B < E, therefore is true.)

II) F > D → False (As A > B < C ≤ D = E ≥ F > G. So, we get D > F, therefore is false.)

Thus, Only conclusion I is true.

questions.question: Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation CORRECT? 48 * 12 - 10 + 6 / 2 = 30
questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation CORRECT?

48 * 12 - 10 + 6 / 2 = 30
questions.solution:
Option 1) * and +

48 * 12 - 10 + 6 / 2 = 30 ⇒ 48 + 12 - 10 * 6 / 2 = 30

⇒ 48 + 12 - 10 * 6 / 2 = 30 ⇒ 48 + 12 - 10 * 3 = 30 ⇒ 48 + 12 - 30 = 30 ⇒ 60 - 30 = 30 ⇒ 30 = 30 (LHS = RHS)

questions.question: Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows. Statement: The city municipal council pipes in massive volumes of fresh water from distant reservoirs every day. Conclusions: I. Local groundwater sources are not sufficient for the city's needs. II. Every household in the city receives piped water. ?
questions.questionHtml:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: The city municipal council pipes in massive volumes of fresh water from distant reservoirs every day.

Conclusions: I. Local groundwater sources are not sufficient for the city's needs.

II. Every household in the city receives piped water. ?
questions.solution:
I. Local groundwater sources are not sufficient for the city's needs. → Follow

If the city must pipe in massive volumes of water from distant reservoirs daily, it implies that local water sources such as groundwater are insufficient to meet the city's demand.

II. Every household in the city receives piped water. → Does not Follow

The statement does not say that piped water reaches every household, it inly refers to the city's supply system.

Thus, Only Conclusion I follows.

questions.question: Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows. Statement: Universities are instructed to provide digital-only certificates to students except in special cases. Conclusions: I. Physical certificates were often lost or damaged. II. This initiative will help reduce paper consumption. ?
questions.questionHtml:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: Universities are instructed to provide digital-only certificates to students except in special cases.

Conclusions: I. Physical certificates were often lost or damaged.

II. This initiative will help reduce paper consumption. ?
questions.solution:
I. Physical certificates were often lost or damaged. → Does not Follow

The statement gives no information about certificates being lost or damaged.

II. This initiative will help reduce paper consumption. → Follow

Providing digital-only-certificates will naturally reduce the use of paper.

Thus, Only Conclusion II follows.

questions.question: P and Q are partners in a business. P invests 10,000 for a period of 2 years. Q invests 15,000 for a period of 3 years. If P's share of the total profit is 2,000, what is Q's share of the profit?

questions.solution:
So, Total P contributed → Rs 10,000 × 2 yrs = Rs 20,000

So, Total Q contributed → Rs 15,000 × 3 yrs = Rs 45,000

∴ Profit ratio of P : Q = 20000 : 45000 ⇒ P : Q = 4 :9

P's profit = Rs 2,000 ⇒ 2000 : Q = 4 : 9  ⇒ Q = Rs 4,500

questions.question: If 6 % 2 = 36 and 5 % 2 = 25, what is 4 % 2?
questions.solution:
6 % 2 = 36 → 62 = 36

5 % 2 = 25 → 52 = 25

4 % 2 → 42 = 16
